description: couchbase-cli-setting-autoreprovision.md's --enabled flag description reads: 'Specifies whether or not auto-reprovisioning is enabled. Set this option to "1" to enable autofailover or "0" to disable autofailover.' The flag and command are about auto-REPROVISIONING; the second sentence names auto-FAILOVER instead, verbatim-matching the equivalent sentence's subject in couchbase-cli-setting-autofailover.md - direct copy-paste from the sibling command's page, left uncorrected.
